definition: [ פָּעַר ] verb open wide (the mouth) (Late Hebrew rarely = Biblical Hebrew, usually open bowels, go to stool; compare Jewish-Aramaic פְּעַר ; Arabic and Syriac = Biblical Hebrew, chasm ); — Qal Perfect of voracious greed, figurative 3 feminine singular וּפָֽעֲרָה פִּיהָ Isa 5:14 (of Sheôl), 3 plural פָּֽעֲרוּ עָלַי בְּפִיהֶם ( Ges «GKC:119q»§ 119q ) Job 16:10 of eager desire (good sense), פִּיהֶם פָּֽעֲרוּ Job 29:23 , פִּיפָֿעַרְתִּי Ps 119:131 .
